:::{#thm-taylor-normal-density}
#### Maclaurin polynomial of the standard normal density

The Maclaurin polynomial (@def-maclaurin-polynomial) of degree 3 of the standard normal density
$\normpdf(x) = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}}\expf{-\frac{x^2}{2}}$ is

$$P_3(x) = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}} - \frac{x^2}{2\sqrt{2\pi}}$$

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-miller-taylor-normal-density.

:::
